scope: Root nomination/clarification/focus packet only, existing cached word profile CLI in batches<=16, and narrow GDT6087–51/GDT7661–60 formal report sections. No new target outside the focus, raw TSV, image, source acquisition, author artifact, reserve, contact, Git or shared edits. Profile examples/neighbors were not printed or used; only descriptive aggregates and curated prior limits are retained.
independence: No FB author or other agent review output was read; earlier source review by this same agent supplies no blind source independence. The current report freezes before author review.

count_contract.reader_policy: Three alternative readings of one manuscript, not pooled independent observations. Counts are exact raw groups over the admitted179-selector cache; physical line positions are not sentence roles.

review_findings: All55 formerly unknown IT whole forms were profiled. Their exact focus occurrences are distinguished from all-cache counts; no missing-profile card is treated as absent research.

The focus begins with POLAL and later YC HEEY spelling whole ycheey begins its line; each whole-position profile must be respected. A line-first tendency may support a record/transition role but does not translate it or identify an application command.

Broadly distributed/high-count wholes require an account beyond one fitted source clause. A root/oil, age, anatomy or clinical indication assignment cannot acquire support from one occurrence merely because a source counterpart exists. The remaining counts are obligations, not contradictions before a complete declared syntax is supplied.

Singletons and rare forms can accommodate locally free source-conditioned values but provide little distributional discrimination. Rare-value fit is a paid assumption, not an independent lexical anchor.

GDT766 narrow census supports an early noninitial content-field geometry for its declared observed containing-ofch cohort, including a family relevant to exact qofchedy. It does not establish root, oil, age, a state change or an imperative; no global ofch value or unseen-form export is permitted.

GDT608 directed formal composition plus better whole-form residuals requires preserving order and exact whole distinctions. Its q-entry and y/dy-closure profiles are formal edges; no heat/mix/take/old meanings follow. Old operator maps are fixed hypotheses, not confirmed linguistic morphology.

No nominal-role prior among these descriptors supplies ROOT or OIL identity. Root is compatible with a nominal drug-stock class; oil is compatible with a nominal liquid class. This category compatibility neither selects those specializations nor proves coidentity between carrier and later application material.

OLD must modify an actually bound oil entity under new explicit syntax if the source-specific interpretation is attempted. Neither position, repetition, visible suffix nor passage adjacency supplies modifier ownership by itself.

A nominal application event can in principle consume a named material and recipient, but its argument relation is newly paid unless independently evidenced. Turning an old flow predicate into clinical smearing or treating mouth as an anatomical patient site would alter positive frozen commitments unless separately represented.

Source-specific cooking/boiling, clinical application and patient/site/indication continuation require added written consumers distinct from original stream/episode/readiness/coidentity histories. Free variable names do not bind them.
IT versus ZL/RF joined/separated shapes remain exact-whole differences. No new alias, l-prefix law, fused-word segmentation or reader-consensus translation is justified by these profiles.

Profile prior evidence is a curated subset. Most entries carry only the generic WE009 formal composition observation; this does not show an independent nominal classification for each word. Other prior IDs are listed, but no uninspected meaning-bearing claim from them is promoted.

primary_scope.claim: Declared43exactcontaining-ofchoccurrences/25forms and strictprefix25/13 cohort show earlynoninitialcontentfielddistribution; no substance identity. No whole dictionary or target lines outside focus read here.

output_limit_correction: Initial full focus/profile printing was truncated; no omitted material was relied on. Focus schema was parsed explicitly and all formerly unknown IT forms were re-profiled with complete compact counts in this artifact. All prior dictionaries/history remain unchanged.
decision: Proceed only as an explicit unconfirmed whole-context author attempt with paid role/identity/modifier/clinical consumers. Descriptive counts neither confirm the source-specialized root/oil account nor reject it without its exact authored syntax. Preserve frequent-word and alternate-reader obligations for postfreeze review.
mutations: Only FB_WORD_PRIOR_REVIEW.json. No author packet, original parent, route, ledger or registry edited.
